# <span id="aanchor261"></span> Volume Editor

## Exceptions Tab

Exceptions can be viewed on the Flow Data’s Detail Editor. The user will go to the Exceptions tab and view all applicable exceptions for the time frame.

<div class="procedure">

To access the Exceptions tab:

1.  Go to **Open** \> **Volume Editor**.
2.  Select a meter and time period.
3.  Double-click a record.
4.  Click the **Exceptions** tab.



<img src="data:image/png;base64," class="ScreenShot" style="width: 543;height: 168;" />

</div>

<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="Details">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />Screen Details</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="Details">

The following items are available on the Exceptions tab:

- **Date** - Date of the record that the exception was generated for.
- **Status** - A one or two character code indicating if the exception is Acknowledged(A), Pending (P), Resoluved by Late Data (RD), Resolved by User (RU) or Unresolved (U). Users can click on the funnel in the column header to filter which exception types are viewed.
- **Category** - Whether exception was generated based on Flow Data, Characteristics, or Analysis. Users can click on the funnel in the column header to filter which exception categories are viewed.
- **Number** - The exception number.
- **Description** - The exception description

</div>

<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="Edit">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />Editing Exceptions</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="Edit">

When an edit of data is initiated from the Flow Data tab, the user can select the exceptions tab on the Detail Editor. Exceptions for the record are visible there.

<div class="procedure">

To edit an exception:

1.  Click **Edit** at the top of the editor and then select one or more exceptions and click one of the three buttons at the bottom.
2.  Once any changes are made, click **Apply**.
3.  Enter an edit reason if needed.

</div>

</div>
